retractions.sms_marketing_opt_out: keeps a saved phone stage and does not authorize an SMS

record_mapping.email_verified_when: emailVerified is true, or verification status is verified, or verifiedAt is set. Google and Apple rows use the same flags after the provider check in socialAuth/complete.ts alreadyVerified.
record_mapping.email_signup_when: an email lead exists and the verified flags are false
record_mapping.email_none_when: the loaded record has no email. Current joinWaitlist requires an email, so this state is not produced. Score the phone stage only when the caller sets phone_only_lead_valid true.
record_mapping.email_unknown_when: the email columns were not loaded. Do not treat that as no signup.
record_mapping.phone_qualifies_when: the Phone column was loaded and is non-empty. SMS marketing consent is recorded beside the score and does not grant or remove the stage. A saved phone is not proof of ownership and does not authorize an SMS.
record_mapping.phone_unknown_when: the Phone column was not loaded. An empty Phone cell is absent. A missing SMS consent column is unknown consent, not an unknown phone.
record_mapping.payment_qualifies_when: reservation mirror loaded, mode live, paid true, amount 300 USD cents, currency usd, product watchdive_reservation_fee, webhook-verified settlement, refunded cents 0, refund pending cents 0, dispute none or won
record_mapping.payment_unknown_when: the reservation mirror was not loaded. Do not treat a missing mirror as unpaid.
record_mapping.exclude_when: suspect is true or verification status is suppressed. Those scores stay null.

emission.idempotency: Recomputing the score is safe. A future Purchase event_id must be the payment id. Meta dedupes the same event_name and event_id; a new id would count again. This module does not send.
